holderQuote: The Silver-rank adventurers paused a moment before they realized Bevussa was moving.
The Wings of Pallass joined Bevussa and she pointed.
Bevussa called out and the Silver-rank teams cheered.
Yvlon murmured it as she shook Reikhle’s paw. The [Master Builder] looked Yvlon up and down, and only now did someone broach the topic of her arms.
[Master Builder] Reikhle was a Gnoll. He hailed from Pallass, and he was all business. He didn’t even blink as he turned to see the Horns of Hammerad.
I bet Master Reikhle doesn’t see it that way.
Ceria watched as the burly adventurer was shouted into working by Master Reikhle.
Slowly, the Gnoll [Master Builder] rubbed his fur.
